title: Safco AlphaBetter Height-Adjustable Student Desk
body_html:
Let students stand, move, and focus — without leaving their desk.

The AlphaBetter adjustable-height desk gives grade 3–12 students the freedom to sit or stand through the school day and fidget without distracting the class. A 16-gauge commercial-grade steel frame stands up to the toughest classroom conditions, while the book box and swinging footrest bar keep students organized and engaged.

Key features

  • Height adjusts 29″–43″ for seated or standing use
  • Swinging footrest bar lets students fidget without distraction
  • 200 lb worksurface capacity
  • 16-gauge commercial-grade steel frame
  • Molded book box keeps supplies organized

Who it’s for

Grade 3–12 classrooms and active-learning environments that let students move, stand, and focus.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
